chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 18: Li Huowang Rewrites the Heavenly Scripture to Poison Danyangzi
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang becomes Danyangzi’s close-door disciple and immediately fabricates a deadly alchemical formula. Can he keep his lies straight long enough to poison the mad master?
og_title: Playing Alchemist with a Madman—Li Huowang’s Deadly Prescription
og_description: A promotion to close-door disciple becomes the perfect cover for murder. Li Huowang rewrites the Heavenly Scripture with arsenic and cinnabar, setting a trap for his would-be executioner.
